title: OddsFlow Real-Money Results Row
description: One aggregated row of real-money bets placed by OddsFlow AI agents at sportsbooks, settled at the book, with a PDF proof link. All markets included (AH/OU/1X2).

bets.description: Number of individual real-money bets aggregated in this row.

staked.description: Total real money staked across the row's bets.

profit_loss.description: Net settled profit/loss for the row (negative = loss).

roi_pct.description: Row ROI as a percentage = profit_loss / staked * 100.

pdf_proof.description: URL to the sportsbook PDF proof certificate for this bet/match.
